text:
Under the 1944 treaty, Mexico owes the U.S. a share of the water that feeds the Rio Grande. The last cycle closed deep in debt in Oct 2025. Mexico says it met its new 350,000 acre-foot minimum this year, but by most estimates it still owes more than 800,000 acre-feet.

Watch the full breakdown on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=auormf6yM2Q

Sources: U.S. State Dept./USDA; Rio Times; Texas Politics. Narration is AI-generated. Not financial advice.
